Name: Housewarming Party
Author: secsky3
Description:
[b]Description
Housewarming Party eliminates the tedious Spring 1 chore of hunting down 28 villagers across Pelican Town by bringing the welcoming committee straight to your farmhouse. Led by Mayor Lewis, the townsfolk arrive for a streamlined, brisk greeting relay complete with customized dialogue, day-one friendship points, automatic introductory quest completion, and lore-friendly gifts. The mod seamlessly handles mid-game expansions, automatically triggering a secondary visit whenever new NPC mods are installed on an existing save while strictly respecting story unlocks and lore boundaries.[/b]


[b]Installation instructions[/b]
[list]
[*]Ensure [b]SMAPI (4.0+)[/b] and [b]Stardew Valley (1.6+)[/b] are installed.[/*]
[*]Download the [b]Housewarming Party[/b] mod archive.[/*]
[*]Unzip the archive and place the
[code]HousewarmingParty[/code]folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*][i](Optional)[/i] Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] to manage all configuration options in-game.[/*]
[/list][b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Optional Morning Prompt:[/b] Waking up triggers a confirmation dialog asking if you want to receive the housewarming party. Choosing [No] lets you bypass the sequence and begin farming immediately.[/*]
[*][b]Streamlined Villager Relay:[/b] Mayor Lewis leads villagers inside sequentially at an accelerated walk speed (Speed 4 by default, fully adjustable) to keep the interaction brief and punchy.[/*]
[*][b]Mid-Game NPC Mod Integration:[/b] Adding NPC mods like SVE or RSV mid-playthrough triggers a morning prompt whenever unencountered modded characters are detected, initiating a focused greeting event only for the newcomers.[/*]
[*][b]Gifts & Multi-Chest Placement:[/b] Every visitor brings a lore-friendly gift (Robin brings wood, Gus brings salad, Evelyn brings cookies, Lewis brings starter seeds and bonus gold). If gifts exceed 36 slots, additional chests spawn automatically across empty floor tiles to prevent lost items.[/*]
[*][b]Toggleable Gift Rewards:[/b] Players who prefer pure roleplay without material perks can disable gifts entirely (
[code]EnableChest[/code]) via GMCM or
[code]config.json[/code]to receive only greetings.[/*]
[*][b]Full SVE & RSV Support:[/b] Dynamic detection assigns tailored gifts and properly parsed dialogue (resolving
[code]@[/code],
[code]%farm[/code], and gender splits) for custom characters from [i]Stardew Valley Expanded[/i] and [i]Ridgeside Village[/i].[/*]
[*][b]Lore-Safe & Spoiler Filtering:[/b] Characters that cannot logically be reached on Day 1 (Krobus, Dwarf, Sandy, Wizard, Kent, Leo, locked expansion NPCs) are excluded from the visit.[/*]
[*][b]Automatic Quest & Relationship Progression:[/b] Instantly completes the "Introductions" quest (28/28), awards +20 friendship points across the board, and consumes initial introduction dialogue flags so subsequent town interactions trigger everyday dialogue.[/*]
[*][b]"Omedetou" Thumbnail Scene:[/b] Typing
[code]omedetou[/code]into the SMAPI console stages a 15-second screenshot freeze where villagers encircle the player with applause and chat bubbles.[/*]
[*][b]GMCM In-Game Configuration:[/b] Adjust mod toggles, quest auto-completion, gift chest activation, bonus gold amounts (0–5000g), mid-game detection, and relay walk speeds (2–6) directly in-game.[/*]
[*][b]Dual-Language Support:[/b] Full native localization for both English and Korean.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley[/b] (v1.6 or higher)[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] (v4.0.0 or higher)[/*]
[*][i](Optional)[/i] [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] for in-game configuration.[/*]
[/list][b]Shout outs[/b]
[list]
[*][b]ConcernedApe[/b] for creating [i]Stardew Valley[/i] and providing persistent modding support.[/*]
[*][b]Pathoschild[/b] and the SMAPI development team for the core framework enabling complex event manipulation.[/*]
[*][b]FlashShifter[/b] ([i]Stardew Valley Expanded[/i]) and the [b]Ridgeside Village[/b] development team for their extensive NPC frameworks and creative inspiration.[/*]
[*]The [i]Neon Genesis Evangelion[/i] production team for inspiring the celebratory
[code]omedetou[/code]scene.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]☕ Support & Media[/b][/size] If you enjoy this mod and would like to support future development:
